title: Paid in Full, 3 continents
hook: Paid in Full borrows its bassline from a Temptation.
voiceover: Paid in Full borrows its bassline from a Temptation. Dennis Edwards sang lead for the Temptations. In 1984 he went solo with Don't Look Any Further on Gordy, a duet with Siedah Garrett, and that bassline is the whole hook of the record. 1987, Eric B and Rakim take the bassline and put the drums from the Soul Searchers' Ashley's Roachclip underneath it. Then Coldcut remix it in London and drop in Ofra Haza, an Israeli singer, performing Im Nin'alu, a Yemenite Jewish poem, over the top. The Seven Minutes of Madness mix went top 20 in the UK. Detroit, Washington, Tel Aviv and London on 1 record in 1987. Save this. Which flip next?
caption: Paid in Full (Eric B and Rakim, 4th and Broadway, 1987). Bassline from Dennis Edwards' Don't Look Any Further (Gordy, 1984), drums from the Soul Searchers' Ashley's Roachclip (1974), and in Coldcut's Seven Minutes of Madness remix, Ofra Haza's Im Nin'alu, a Yemenite Jewish poem, on top. Four cities, one record, before anyone was clearing samples. Which flip do you want Thursday?
